articles.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

articles.title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
articles.snippet: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

articles.title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
articles.snippet: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

articles.title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
articles.snippet: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.
